findings.title: Stage-A fold-positive-share gate stated with INVERTED direction — drift from A4 BINDING control BC-5
findings.evidence: plans/PLAN_stocks_ng6.md §6 line 255-256: 'Plus the frozen stocks Stage-A gates on any survivor: fold-positive-share <= 50%, largest-fold concentration <= 50%, MDD <= 15%, ...'. A4 BINDING control BC-5 (sng6-a4-hostile-critic-dossier.json axis 5 binding_control, line 65): 'Stage-A gates bound: SPY-excess positive in >= 2/3 folds, MDD <= 15%, fold-positive-share > 50%, largest-fold concentration of positive PnL <= 50%, ...'. The plan's sentence is a pass-condition list (every other item is an upper bound a survivor must satisfy), so as literally written a survivor would need at most half its folds positive — a nonsense/over-kill reading that contradicts the binding control. The defect originates in A2's own house_stage_A_on_survivors sentence ('fold-positive-share <= 50%') which A4 corrected; the plan copied A2's form inside a list that claims to carry the frozen Stage-A gates. Program precedent confirms intent: V13 died at 'folds positive 1/3' and V11's anchor lists 'fold-positive share 0.5034' among its FAILING gate values (HYPOTHESIS_LEDGER.md V11/V13 rows), so the operative frozen bar is at least majority-positive (possibly >= 2/3).
findings.remediation: Restate the gate in the A4 BC-5 binding form ('fold-positive-share > 50%') or quote the frozen Stage-A source verbatim if its bar is stricter (e.g. >= 2/3); one-token plan edit + dossier-consistent restatement. Re-check that no other Stage-A item was copied from A2 where A4's binding form differs.

findings.title: A4 BINDING control BC-7 (death contract) only partially adopted; frozen convention puts synthetic mark-to-last exit fills INSIDE the scored expectancy — live invalid-PASS path
findings.evidence: plans/PLAN_stocks_ng6.md §6 lines 257-260: 'death-censoring invariance (excluding in-horizon deaths must not flip the verdict — ...; deaths inside H=10 force-flat at last served session and INCLUDED)'; §8 line 287: 'force-flat at fold boundary and at death (last served session; DEATH_CENSORED flagged, included)'. A4 BINDING control BC-7 (sng6-a4 axis 7 binding_control + binding_controls_summary line 101): 'in-horizon death census at P0; synthetic mark-to-last exits excluded from expectancy numerator (frozen convention); dual death-censoring invariance (family verdict AND each gate); DEATH_CENSORED flags persisted'; axis-7 detail: 'a synthetic fill must never silently enter the scored expectancy'. Drift in three parts: (1) the plan freezes the opposite convention (synthetic last-served-price exits INCLUDED in expectancy) — on a death-inclusive cohort a stale last-served price is non-executable and can systematically inflate expectancy; flagging mitigates silence but not inclusion; (2) the P0 in-horizon (t+1..t+11) death census per fold required by BC-7(1) is absent — F4's 'death-inclusive cohort census; per-name served-session census' is a cohort census, not the event-level in-horizon census; (3) BC-7(3) requires the invariance gate to bind on the family verdict AND every Stage-A gate's pass/fail; the plan carries verdict-only ('excluding in-horizon deaths must not flip the verdict').
findings.remediation: Adopt BC-7 in full in the plan: (a) add the per-fold in-horizon death census to F4/P0 gates; (b) freeze the exit-fill rule in the BC-7 form — death-session open if served, else mark-to-last-served EXCLUDED from the expectancy numerator with separate censored-leg accounting (or, if inclusion is retained, the deviation must be argued against axis-7's explicit ruling, which the current plan does not do); (c) extend death-censoring invariance to 'the verdict AND every Stage-A gate's pass/fail'; (d) DEATH_CENSORED flags persisted per leg (already partially present in §8).

findings.title: A4 BINDING control BC-6 partial: P0 event-population band-C fraction measurement missing
findings.evidence: A4 BC-6 (sng6-a4 axis 6 binding_control, line 73): 'fraction of events resolving to band C measured at P0 on the EVENT population (not cohort average) — if the event population is majority-band-C, the 100 bps/rt ceiling must be reported as the operative stress number'. Plan F6 carries the band schedule, fail-closed resolution, stress-2.0 primary gate, P-21 ceiling and break-even forms, but nowhere mandates the event-population (not cohort-average) band-C fraction measurement at P0, nor the majority-band-C operative-stress-number reporting rule.
